category_title: Students with or at-risk for Emotional and Behavioral Disorders (EBD) exhibiting disruptive and off-task behaviors
minimal_context: The student is assigned an independent reading task while the teacher works at their desk.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please begin your independent reading task. I am going to be working at my desk.

STUDENT: (Looks at the assigned materials briefly, then looks away, not actively completing the assigned task.)

TUTOR: Keep reading your book.

STUDENT: (Sits back, neither actively engaged nor looking at the teacher or assigned work.)

TUTOR: I need to finish this paperwork at my desk.

STUDENT: (Gets out of seat and starts texting, engaging in an activity that is incompatible with the assigned task.) If you don't bother me I won't bother you.

options.A: Terminate the demands and remove the reading materials for ten seconds.
options.B: Break the reading task down into smaller chunks so it can be completed.
options.C: Present clear expectations for the reading task and provide positive acknowledgement.
options.D: Follow through to help the student comply with the direction to read.
